text.en: In what order are the capstone pipeline's steps?

tr: İzle, tetikle, doğrula, eğit, kapıdan geçir
en: Monitor, trigger, validate, train, pass the gate

explanation.en: The loop turns every month.

text.en: What does the pipeline's state (`state`) hold?

tr: Canlı model, eğitildiği veri, sürüm ve kapı skoru
en: The live model, the data it was trained on, the version and the gate score

explanation.tr: Gerçek bir hatta bu bilgi model kaydında durur.
explanation.en: In a real pipeline this lives in the model registry.

text.tr: `drift` fonksiyonu neden en büyük PSI'yi verir?
text.en: Why does the `drift` function give the largest PSI?

tr: Bir sütunun kayması tetik için yeter
en: One column drifting is enough for the trigger

explanation.en: All numeric columns are checked.

text.tr: İzleme adımında kayma ve doğruluk neden farklı aylara bakar?
text.en: In the monitoring step, why do drift and accuracy look at different months?

tr: Etiket gecikmesi: bugünün girdisi var, etiketi geçen ayınki
en: The label delay: today's inputs are there, the labels are last month's

explanation.en: `today` has no labels, `holdout` does.

text.tr: Eşikler neden adlarıyla en başta yazıldı?
text.en: Why are the thresholds written with names at the top?

tr: Tasarım belgesindeki kararlardır; okunur ve değiştirilir
en: They are the decisions in the design document; they can be read and changed

explanation.en: `MAX_DROP`, `MAX_DRIFT`, `MAX_INVALID`, `MIN_GAIN`.

text.tr: Hat hangi durumda hiçbir şey yapmaz?
text.en: When does the pipeline do nothing?

tr: Doğruluk `MAX_DROP` kadar düşmediyse ve kayma `MAX_DRIFT`'i aşmadıysa
en: If accuracy didn't drop by `MAX_DROP` and drift didn't exceed `MAX_DRIFT`

explanation.en: Months 1, 2 and 7.

text.en: What is the training window?

en: The customers of the last two months

explanation.en: We measured it in the Concept Drift section.

text.en: What does `BROKEN` imitate?

tr: Veri kaynağının 5. ayda ücretleri kuruşa çevirmesini
en: The data source switching the fees to cents in month 5

explanation.en: The error from the Data Validation section.

text.en: On which set is the candidate measured?

tr: Canlı modelle aynı güncel, etiketli kümede
en: The same current, labelled set as the live model

explanation.tr: Kavram Kayması'ndaki kapı tuzağına düşmemek için.
explanation.en: To avoid the gate trap from Concept Drift.

text.tr: Dersteki sekiz ayda 3. ayda ne oldu?
text.en: In the lesson's eight months, what happened in month 3?

en: The drift was large (0.578), v2 passed

explanation.en: Candidate 0.782, live 0.778.

text.en: Why did the candidate stay out in month 4?

en: It wasn't better than the live model (0.784 < 0.787)

explanation.tr: Kayma tetikledi ama kapı gereksiz bir değişikliği durdurdu.
explanation.en: The drift triggered, but the gate stopped a pointless change.

text.en: What does month 4 show us?

tr: Kayma tek başına model değiştirmez; kararı kapı verir
en: Drift alone doesn't change the model; the gate decides

explanation.en: The trigger only produces a candidate.

text.en: What happened in month 5?

en: Accuracy fell to 0.691 but the data was rejected

explanation.en: The whole window was invalid.

text.tr: Bozuk veriyle eğitilen aday, aynı bozuk kaynaktan gelen kümede kaç aldı?
text.en: How did the candidate trained on broken data score on a set from the same broken source?

en: 0.784: it would have passed the gate

explanation.tr: Kapının kümesi de bozuksa kapı aldanır.
explanation.en: If the gate's set is broken too, the gate is fooled.

text.tr: Aynı aday kaynak düzeldikten sonra temiz veride kaç alırdı?
text.en: What would the same candidate score on clean data after the source was fixed?

explanation.tr: Doğrulama bu yüzden kapıdan önce gelir.
explanation.en: That's why validation comes before the gate.

text.en: What is the price of rejecting the data?

tr: Müşteriler bir ay daha eski modelle karşılaşır
en: Customers face the old model for one more month

explanation.tr: Bu yüzden ret bir uyarı da göndermeli.
explanation.en: That's why a rejection should also send an alert.

text.en: What happened in month 6?

explanation.en: The source isn't broken anymore.

text.en: Why was drift small in month 7 (0.127)?

tr: Referans artık v3'ün eğitildiği yeni veri
en: The reference is now the new data v3 was trained on

explanation.en: When the model changes, the reference changes too.

text.en: What does `"0 3 1 * *"` mean in the lesson's workflow?

explanation.tr: Alanlar: dakika, saat, ayın günü, ay, haftanın günü.
explanation.en: The fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.

text.en: Why is `workflow_dispatch` in the workflow?

tr: Hattı elle de başlatmak için: kalite uyarısında takvimi beklemeden
en: To start the pipeline by hand too: without waiting for the schedule on a quality alert

explanation.en: "Both" from Concept Drift.

text.en: Why does the `retrain` job have `needs: test`?

en: So the pipeline doesn't run before the tests pass

explanation.en: No model is trained with broken code.

text.tr: Raporu yükleyen adımda `if: always()` neden var?
text.en: Why does the step uploading the report have `if: always()`?

tr: Hat düşse de rapor saklansın diye
en: So the report is kept even if the pipeline fails

explanation.en: The report shows why it failed.

text.en: What should a version enter the registry with?

en: Its data digest, measurements and threshold

explanation.en: For rolling back and auditing.

text.tr: Kapıdan geçen yeni sürüm hemen herkese açılır mı?
text.en: Is a new version that passed the gate opened to everyone at once?

tr: Hayır; önce gölge ve kanaryadan geçer
en: No; it goes through shadow and canary first

explanation.tr: A/B Testi, Gölge ve Kanarya bölümü.
explanation.en: The A/B Tests, Shadow and Canary section.
